purpose: Cover US-17405 (D4/D5/D2 bites, PR 6): the four new checks stories:closedSets, stories:ownerRefResolves, crosscut:catalogue and skeleton:standardsCited each have pass, fail, notApplicable, id and why strings; the concern-catalogue applicability table is validated; --check crosscut exits 4 on an unacknowledged D5 failure and 0 when the freeze record acknowledges define.crosscut at the current tree hash; validate adds no finding for a missing AC class marker.
title: DEFINE step 3 PR 6: D4 closed sets and ownerRef findings, D5 concern catalogue, standards citation

testCases.description: An AC description with an enumeration cue (status is one of the following) and no bracketed list or ownerRef fails stories:closedSets with the AC id and why 'enumeration cue without a closed set'.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (PR 6, AC-17405-1): closedSets fails an AC with an enumeration cue and no bracketed list or ownerRef

testCases.description: An AC description that quotes an enumeration cue (e.g. the user types "status is" into the search box) does not fail stories:closedSets.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (PR 6, AC-17405-1): closedSets honours the quoted-cue guard shared with D6

testCases.description: An ownerRef { tacId, field: interfaces[loan] } that resolves on that TAC passes stories:ownerRefResolves; interfaces[missing] fails with 'ownerRef does not resolve'.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (PR 6, AC-17405-2): ownerRefResolves passes a resolving pointer and fails a missing one

testCases.description: A persistence REQ with retention applied and timeAndTimezone waived (with a reason) passes crosscut:catalogue; the pair totals cover the full applicability map.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (PR 6, AC-17405-3): crosscut:catalogue passes a persistence REQ with retention applied and timeAndTimezone waived

testCases.description: An httpApi REQ with no errorEnvelope entry fails crosscut:catalogue with id <REQ>:errorEnvelope and a why naming the missing pair.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (PR 6, AC-17405-4): crosscut:catalogue fails <REQ>:errorEnvelope when the httpApi REQ has no concern-ledger entry

testCases.description: A registered standards pack cited in an ADR passes skeleton:standardsCited; uncited and unwaived, it fails standards:<pack> with 'uncited and unwaived'; waiver via a concern-ledger entry keyed standards:<pack> also passes.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (PR 6, AC-17405-5): standardsCited passes when cited or waived; fails when neither

testCases.description: rcf define validate (as it stands in this PR) raises no finding for a story whose ACs carry no class marker; decision 10 preserved.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/validate.test.js::validate cli (PR 6, AC-17405-6): no finding is raised for a missing AC class marker

testCases.description: rcf define readiness --check crosscut exits 4 on an unacknowledged D5 failure and 0 when the freeze record acknowledges define.crosscut at the current tree hash.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/readiness.test.js::readiness cli: AC-17405 --check crosscut exits 4 unacked and 0 acked at current hash

testCases.description: applicableConcernsFor returns the exact spec section 4 D5 catalogue row: auth for auth/httpApi; errorEnvelope for httpApi/cliCommand; loggingAudit for every shape but other; retention for persistence; performance for httpApi/batch; secrets for auth/externalIntegration; timeAndTimezone for persistence/batch; concurrencyIdempotency for httpApi/persistence.
testCases.testPointer: test/define/concern-catalogue.test.js::concern-catalogue (PR 6): applicability table matches spec section 4 D5

testCases.description: The engineer checks stories:closedSets, stories:ownerRefResolves, crosscut:catalogue and skeleton:standardsCited surface no product-owner failures on the loop fixture from PR 2.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/questions-loop.test.js::PR 6 engineer checks surface no product-owner failures on the scripted fixture

testCases.description: R11 widens stories:ownerRefResolves beyond interfaces[<name>] to responsibilities[<n>] and bare schema fields (purpose, decision).
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (PR 9, AC-17405-2 R11): ownerRefResolves accepts bracket-grammar paths beyond interfaces (responsibilities[<n>], purpose, decision)

testCases.description: R11 refuses dotted grammar; rcf define validate reports the finding naming the dotted field.
testCases.testPointer: test/define/validate-findings.test.js::validate findings (PR 9, R11): ownerRef uses the widened grammar; deliveredBy object form is checked

testCases.description: A concern-ledger entry concern 'standards:<pack>' with disposition 'applied' satisfies skeleton:standardsCited (R8 2026-10-05); 'waived' also satisfies it; neither nor cited, the pack fails standards:<pack>.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (R8, AC-17405-5): applied disposition satisfies standardsCited alongside waived and citation

testCases.description: A D2 scope narrowed so no REQ, PRD, TAD or brief statement is in scope but a registered standards pack is neither cited nor waived tree-wide still fails skeleton:standardsCited (stage state failing, not notApplicable) via the ADR-4138 helper.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (R7, AC-17405-9): standardsCited runs tree-wide under narrowed D2 scope
